reviews.text: My puppy had her first groom with Bree yesterday. She came out absolutely gorgeous and smelling amazing, wearing an outrageously cute bandana! Fantastic service! Highly recommended!
Nice zoo with a lot of animals and cafe on territory if you have 2-3 hours go there and relax:)
Bree is an excellent groomer who provides an excellent service.

My puppy, Lexi , a 1 year old
Mal- Shi had her grooming with Bree today. I'm v particular and fussy about her appearance, and I have to say  I'm absolutely delighted with her grooming. She's even more adorable now. Thank you Bree 😊 …
